meta.purpose: Scripted reproduction of the OpenAI Health/Whisper zero-current baseline+delta overlay incident: the current lane returns a true zero-result response, the former lane returns a small scoped delta, and terminal public APIs must serve a baseline+delta view instead of a raw delta-only result view.

live_reference.failure_mechanism: The backend completed the job but result view publication could point at only the delta snapshot. Manual refresh then exposed a frontend fetch failure instead of a stable baseline+delta candidate board.
